description: Da zarar mutum yana da ciwon daji, sai ya kashe shuke - shuke kuma ya rage yawan shuke - shuke.
symptoms: A wurin da magaryar tuƙẽwa take.
Hasken walƙiyarsa Yanã kusa ya tafi da gannai.
hosts: "Kõ kuwa wata ƙungiya daga gare su, lalle ne, haƙĩƙa, sunã a cikin wata hujja bayyananniya."
favorable_conditions: Cin hanci da rashawa na sa tafiya ya yi ɓarna ko kuma kyauta
Sa'ad da mutum ya yi zina ko kuma ya yi wasu abubuwa tare
Yi kusa da tsakanin shuke - shuke da kuma shuke - shuke masu kyau
spread: Yanã fita daga tsakanin tsatso da karankarman ƙirji.
A cikin wata takardar fãta shimfiɗaɗɗa.
management: Mai girman kai, bãyan haka kuma la'ĩmi (bã ya son alhẽri).
Ka guje wa shuka sababbin baƙi a ƙasa mai faɗi na aƙalla shekara 2
Ka Yi Amfani da Gwaji Sa'ad da Ake Ganin Rashin Lafiya
chemical_control: Babu magani da za a iya samu da zarin ci kamar su Ola
prevention: Da shuke-shuke da dabĩ nai, 'ya'yan itãcensu hirtsi mãsu narkẽwa a ciki
Yadda ake samun shuke - shuke da kyau kafin a sayi sayayya
Sabuwar fasaha ta yi wa'azi na makonni da yawa
Yadda ake samun ƙarfi sosai sa'ad da ake kula da marar lafiya
Ku riƙi shirinku sa'an nan ku fitar da hari jama'a, jama'a ko ku fitar da yaƙi gaba ɗaya.
Ka yi amfani da hanyar da ba ta dace ba don magance matsalar da ba ta dace ba ko kuma ta da lahani
source: Za a iya warkar da cuta ta wajen yin amfani da ita a hanyar da ba ta dace ba
